evidence: The Si substrate is kept at 140 °C during ALD growth, that is, during alternative pulses of tBu-AllylCo(CO)3 and dimethylhydrazine separated by N 2-purge. The tBu-AllylCo(CO)3 precursor is exposed by a 2-s pulse using ultrapure N 2 carrier gas (flow rate = 10 sccm, P ∼ 20 mTorr) through an ampule kept at 35 °C. The dimethylhydrazine is introduced by a 1-s pulse, drawn directly from the reservoir at room temperature (9 Torr vapor pressure).
